item.title: WRE News: Pilates Dominates Miami’s Fitness Scene in 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 17, 2025 - Miami is stretching its way to the top, with Pilates officially crowned the city’s favorite workout of 2025. According to new data from ClassPass shared with Axios, Pilates is not only Miami’s most-booked fitness class this year but also the top workout nationwide for the third year in a row, with reservations jumping 66% year over year. item.description: Miami, FL - December 18, 2025 - A bold new proposal could transform one of West Brickell’s last undeveloped sites into one of Miami’s most densely packed residential towers.
